title: Review round 1: DO_KDF ikm_fd: use KEY fd as IKM source
description: Review round 1 for epic WOLFKM-1vx (DO_KDF ikm_fd support). Seven agents review simultaneously.
notes: Confidence: 5% chance of missed bug. Reasoning: Seven agents reviewed the ikm_fd path covering lock ordering, zeroization, refcount safety, dual-source rejection, PBKDF2 restriction, test vectors, and FIPS gate placement. The P0 report (WOLFKM-c78.1) confirms no correctness bugs found with explicit checklist of six safety properties verified against source. The two SEC2 efficiency findings (WOLFKM-c78.6, WOLFKM-c78.9) describe early-exit ordering; neither identifies a correctness issue, only a minor inefficiency. WOLFKM-c78.3 (over-allocation) and WOLFKM-c78.4 (test name) are labeled opinion — no engineering substance. No P1 maintainer-burden issues filed. The DECISION issues (eight of them) are positive confirmations of correct behavior, not bug reports. The residual 5% reflects that no review is exhaustive: concurrent close(ikm_fd) races during process death and the interaction with fd reference count on process exit were not explicitly traced. Running out of real complaints: yes. P0=0, P1=0, P2=2 (efficiency only, no correctness), P3=0, P4=1 (opinion).
